text:
maya: Heads-up — my PR (https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/inference/pull/4821) is red in CI. Failing typecheck + formatting gates: mypy errors in python/kvcache.py and rustfmt diffs in inference-runtime. CI link: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8971

ci-bot: Build #8971 FAILED · checks: mypy, rustfmt. Logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8971/logs · use /retest to rerun

kevin: ping @sara @alex — can someone triage? I'm on meetings for the next 45m.

sara: on it, grabbing the logs now. maya, can you paste the top mypy snippet here?

maya: sure — copying the error:
```
python/kvcache.py:124: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "int")  [assignment]
    last_seen = None
              ^
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 48 source files)
```

toni: quick thought: we recently bumped pre-commit and the rust-toolchain in the monorepo. rustfmt diffs often come from a toolchain mismatch. locally run: `pre-commit run --all-files` and `rustup show` to confirm toolchain. For python typechecks, try `tox -e typechecks` (it runs mypy with our pinned config).

alex: this could also be CI image drift. If a rerun on the same commit still fails, it's probably deterministic. If it flips, it's flaky. I can kick a bisect if needed.

sara: +1 — I'm rerunning now (/retest). will report back. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: Build #8972 RUNNING (triggered by @sara)

ci-bot: Build #8972 FAILED · same top errors.

sara: same failures on rerun — reproducible. @maya can you try the local pre-commit + tox steps and push a fix?

maya: did that, pre-commit reformatted 2 rust files and flagged that `last_seen` should be Optional[int] in kvcache.py. pushing a tiny fix now.

maya: pushed patch to add Optional[int] and run pre-commit -> https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/inference/commit/7f1a2b

kevin: thanks. I'll watch CI. If this keeps flipping after the patch, we'll open an infra ticket to pin rustfmt/pre-commit versions in the CI image.

ci-bot: Build #8973 RUNNING (commit 7f1a2b)

ci-bot: Build #8973 PASSED · all checks green :white_check_mark:

alex: great — looks like a real change required, not a transient flake. filing a small follow-up to ensure CI images include explicit rustfmt version in the Dockerfile.

toni: note for postmortem: add a short troubleshooting doc for types vs pyright/mypy mismatch; a lot of devs hit this when switching strictness flags.

kevin: solid. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :thumbsup:
